# .sprout workspace

Use `.sprout/config.yaml` for project defaults and `.sprout/commands/<name>/manifest.yaml` to define generators.

## Recommended validation

```bash
sprout list --all
sprout doctor
sprout new <command> name=test
sprout new <command> --json '{"name":"test"}'
```

Runtime notes:
- TTY terminals can offer interactive fill-in for missing required inputs
- Non-TTY environments fail fast instead of waiting for input
- `--json` / `--json-file` are recommended for Agent or script-driven calls
